system.description:
Your movements mirror the duality of the dragon, fury and patience, fire and steel. You strike in mirrored balance, every motion feeding the next.

Whilst in this form, you gain the following modifiers:

- The first time you successfully Strike a creature each round, you gain a +1 bonus to DB until the start of your next turn.

- The first time you successfully avoid an attack each round (your DB is not overcome), you gain +1 base damage until the end of your next turn.

Automated: a Combat Form, entered through Combat Form like your others (1 AP, a stance). The first time each round your Strike hits, +1 class to your DB until the start of your next turn; the first time each round an attack misses you, +1 to your damage until the end of your next turn (untyped, so it adds to a form's class bonuses). It is not counted against Combat Form's table.

parts.label: +1 DB after your first hit each round
+1 base damage after your first avoided attack each round
